source_name: ATVP – Smernice ESMA (adopted/applicable ESMA guidelines register)
why_relevant: Authoritative national list of which ESMA guidelines ATVP has decided to comply with (fully/partly). Compliance decisions are published in Uradni list RS and become effectively binding — this is where MiFID/transparency obligations land nationally.

source_name: ATVP – MiFID II / MiFIR zakonodaja in smernice
why_relevant: Directly scopes investment-services rules that apply to banks (ZTFI-1 implementation of MiFID II/MiFIR): conduct of business, product governance, best execution — all compliance-deadline generators for bank investment arms.

source_name: ATVP – Nadzorniki na finančnem trgu (supervisor cross-reference page)
why_relevant: Official map of Slovenian financial-market supervisors (ATVP, AZN, Banka Slovenije) with links — a compact actor-map seed for expanding the adjacent-supervisor cell.

source_name: UPPD – Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (official gov.si page)
why_relevant: Slovenia's FIU and central AML/CFT authority. Publishes news on ZPPDFT amendments, high-risk third-country lists, typologies, and supervisory expectations that bind banks, payment institutions and VASPs. Confirmed live with recent items (Aug 2026 ZPPDFT amendment on beneficial-ownership register access; MONEYVAL 6th round report).

source_name: UPPD – Smernice (guidelines PDF library on gov.si)
why_relevant: The Office's own guidelines for obliged entities (ocena tveganja PD/FT, sector guidelines). These define concrete control expectations and implementation deadlines for banks and payment institutions.

source_name: UPPD – Mnenja urada o dejanskih lastnikih (opinions library)
why_relevant: Compiled Office opinions on identifying beneficial owners — the practical interpretation banks must apply during customer due diligence; changes here move operational KYC requirements.

source_name: Uradni list RS – Smernice / Sklepi o uporabi smernic (Official Gazette)
why_relevant: Legally authoritative publication point: guidelines and supervisors' 'sklep o uporabi smernic' become binding on publication here, and entry-into-force dates (the actual compliance deadlines) are stated in the text.

source_name: AZN – Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor (Insurance Supervision Agency)
why_relevant: Licenses and supervises banks acting as insurance intermediaries (bančno zavarovalništvo / bancassurance) and insurance agents employed by banks; issues IDD-related obligations, positions and enforcement.

source_name: AZN – Predpisi v pripravi (regulations in preparation / consultations)
why_relevant: AZN's 'Predpisi v pripravi' subsection is the forward-looking consultation channel for subordinate insurance regulation; combined with 'Stališča Agencije' it gives both draft and interpretive positions affecting bank-distributed insurance.

source_name: AZN – Obveznosti po pridobitvi dovoljenja (agents/brokers duties incl. banks)
why_relevant: Sets recurring obligations and reporting deadlines for licensed intermediaries — banks holding AZN authorisation for insurance mediation are in scope.

source_name: AZN – Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: Statutory catalogue listing every category of information the agency holds and publishes — a systematic map for finding non-obvious datasets and FOI (ZDIJZ) request targets.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IP-RS) – Mnenja po Splošni uredbi (GDPR opinions database)
why_relevant: Searchable database of the Slovenian DPA's non-binding but heavily relied-upon opinions. Contains a dense bank/payments cluster (KYC vs GDPR, PEP screening, bank mergers, employment-data processing) that directly shapes bank and PSP data-processing design.

source_name: IP-RS – Mnenja po ZVOP-2 (national data protection act opinions)
why_relevant: ZVOP-2 replaced ZVOP-1 in 2023; opinions issued under it are the current-law interpretations. Older ZVOP-1 opinions must be treated as superseded — important for dating/validity scoring of collected items.

source_name: IP-RS – Novice (news / enforcement and guidance announcements)
why_relevant: Announcement channel for new guidance, inspection priorities, EDPB positions applied nationally, and consultations — the timeliest IP-RS signal for compliance deadlines.

source_name: IP-RS – Umetna inteligenca (AI section: guidance and reporting)
why_relevant: IP-RS has a dedicated AI area (guidance plus violation reporting). As banks/PSPs deploy AI for fraud, scoring and onboarding, this is where the national DPA's AI-Act-adjacent expectations will surface first.

source_name: eUprava / E-demokracija – Predlogi predpisov (national draft-legislation consultation portal)
why_relevant: Single national portal where ministries publish draft laws/regulations for public consultation (typically 30–60 days), including ZPPDFT, ZVOP, ZTFI and ZZavar amendments. Gives the earliest dated view of upcoming bank/PSP obligations, with explicit comment deadlines.

source_name: AJPES – Register dejanskih lastnikov (RDL/eRDL)
why_relevant: The statutory beneficial-ownership register banks and other obliged entities must consult for CDD. Access rules changed (restricted access post-CJEU), and the Aug 2026 ZPPDFT amendment on register access reported by UPPD makes this an active compliance-deadline area for banks and PSPs.

source_name: MONEYVAL (Council of Europe) – Slovenia 6th round mutual evaluation
why_relevant: UPPD reported publication of Slovenia's 6th-round MONEYVAL evaluation. Mutual evaluation findings and the follow-up timetable are the strongest predictor of the next 2–4 years of Slovenian AML legislative and supervisory tightening affecting banks and PSPs.

source_name: GZS – Preprečevanje pranja denarja (Chamber of Commerce AML practitioner hub)
why_relevant: Industry-side digest of AML obligations, seminars and supervisor Q&A. Useful for spotting where obliged entities perceive ambiguity and which deadlines are causing friction — a demand-side signal for compliance services.

source_name: Slovensko zavarovalno združenje (SZZ) – supervisory/practitioner materials
why_relevant: Insurance association publishes presentations on AZN supervision of insurance agents and brokers (including bank channels), giving practitioner-level detail on how supervision is actually conducted.

source_name: PwC Slovenija — Pravne novice (Legal News)
why_relevant: Big Four SI legal arm publishing dated Slovenian-language client alerts on new/amended legislation; historically covers financial-sector and compliance obligations with concrete effective dates and deadlines.

source_name: PwC Slovenija — DORA (Uredba o digitalni operativni odpornosti) advisory page
why_relevant: Slovenian-language practitioner explainer of DORA scope and application dates; typical of adviser content that dates obligations earlier and more plainly than the regulator.

source_name: KPMG Slovenija — insights / news hub
why_relevant: KPMG SI serves financial services as a named priority segment; local insight articles and transparency reporting indicate an ongoing SI-specific publication stream covering regulatory change for banks.

source_name: Deloitte Slovenija — Financial Services (Finančne novičke) article series
why_relevant: Deloitte SI runs a Slovenian-language financial-services newsletter ('Finančne novičke') covering EU fintech/regulatory action plans and non-financial risk in financial institutions — exactly the adviser-translated regulation this cell targets. Recency of the series needs checking (located examples are older).

source_name: EY Slovenija — insights / newsroom
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four office in SI; expected to publish local regulatory and financial-services alerts. Included as a to-verify actor: no SI-specific banking/payments alert stream was surfaced by search in this run.

source_name: Jadek & Pensa — Articles (pravni članki)
why_relevant: Leading Ljubljana full-service firm with a banking & finance and capital markets practice; maintains a dated, authored article stream (verified items from June 2026) across tax, disputes, procurement — a live channel where banking/payments regulatory commentary appears.

source_name: ODI Law — Insights (Publications / Firm news)
why_relevant: SI-headquartered regional firm with an explicitly developed banking & finance practice; verified live insights feed with a 'Publications' category and dated regulatory commentary (items through Aug 2026), paginated back several pages.
